defaults.gateway_params_note: forced on every request of every agent combo (user decisions 2026-10-05/06): effort forced for all: high (2026-10-05), then medium (2026-10-06: high reasoned through the full 32k output with no answer) (omp sent high, mcode medium, others nothing); one output limit for all, because high effort exhausted pi's/mcode's 16k limit in reasoning (stopReason length / EMPTY_RESPONSE). max_tokens is stripped so max_completion_tokens is the only limit. A combo's gateway_params overrides.
defaults.health_note: user decisions 2026-10-06: runs start only while > 70% of SAIA attempts in the last hour succeeded (decided on >= 4 attempts, probing every 15 min while waiting, no time limit); in-flight runs are stopped below 50% over 15 min; a cell gets up to 5 SAIA-caused tries (fairness), then is flagged
